spy_benchmark.note: SPY EOD from perf-log benchmark_value; anchored to the 2026-04-09 model inception EOD.

methodology_notes.cumulative_return: last EOD value / $100,000 inception capital - 1 (== stored cumulative_return field).
methodology_notes.monthly_return: last May EOD value / first May EOD value - 1 (calendar-month window).
methodology_notes.spy_relative_alpha: model cumulative_return - SPY cumulative_return, both anchored to 2026-04-09 EOD.
methodology_notes.max_drawdown: performance[].max_drawdown is May-confined (running peak within May); the underwater chart uses inception-anchored running peak.
methodology_notes.volatility: annualized std of May daily EOD returns (ddof=1) * sqrt(252).
methodology_notes.turnover: performance[].turnover and profiles[].turnover_mean_daily are mean daily executed-notional/EOD-value over May (RQ5 _daily_portfolio_features definition).
methodology_notes.win_rate: day-level: fraction of May trading days with positive EOD return (canonical compute_metrics definition).
methodology_notes.risk_free_rate: 0.0368 annualized (3-month T-bill), as-of inception 2026-04-09; pinned in settings.json.risk_free_rate.
methodology_notes.sharpe: descriptive annualized monthly Sharpe = mean(daily EOD return - rf/252) / std(daily return, ddof=1) * sqrt(252) over the May calendar month; NOT the Deflated Sharpe.
methodology_notes.concentration: evidence_metrics.concentration_mean_daily_hhi is the portfolio-concentration (Herfindahl) measure; mean daily HHI of position weights over May. No separate concentration_hhi field was added.
methodology_notes.notable_events: profiles[].notable_events is objective event extraction (top-3 trades by abs USD value, stop-loss force-sells, drawdown-halt triggers, API/JSON error events) over the calendar month; empty arrays where none.
methodology_notes.halt_gate: all six compute_rqX verified against v1.json; PASS. Cosmetic only: RQ5 metric label cash_pct (code) == cash (v1.json), same quantity.

prompt_version_stamps.note: per-record prompt_version stamp counts over the calendar month's decision records, all models; the regime label derives from these stamps.

provenance.note: generated_at_commit is HEAD at build (build-time; on its own it predates this file and reproduces nothing). source_commit is null at emit: it must point at the commit that reproduces this report, which the builder cannot know before committing. MANDATORY RELEASE GATE -- a published monthly layer must NOT carry a null source_commit: after the data-layer commits, run `git log -1 --format=%H -- reports/monthly/2026-07/data_layer.json` and write that hash into report_meta.source_commit before the report is published. The integrity layer is emitted NATIVELY in this single build from integrity_refs (the Phase-A ledger + the committed de-fab overhang correction), superseding May's three-commit hand chain (generator -> integrity back-fill -> pool relabel).

defab_short_blind_replay.class: committed-then-corrected (pre-publication); same class as the SPY inception-anchor correction
defab_short_blind_replay.cause: scripts/defab_clean_window.py replayed BUY/SELL fills only; the July SHORT/COVER fills (v3/shorting regime) were absent from the de-fab chain, so the two shorted models' clean-window returns excluded all short-side cash and P&L. Detected by the module's own overhang-constant conservation check: DeepSeek clean-window cash drift -726.2341 USD == its realized short P&L to the cent; Gemini +9,213.10 USD cash with 17.5522 shares of untracked short inventory.
defab_short_blind_replay.fix: direction-aware replay: SHORT/COVER fills chain into a separate short book (proceeds credited on SHORT, cover cost paid on COVER, open shorts marked as negative value), with an over-cover probe (the short-side analogue of the oversell probe) and the overhang-constant drift check; legitimate logged shorts are excluded from the infeasibility/trust diagnostics, which continue to measure only phantom long-book negatives and negative cash.
defab_short_blind_replay.verification: May window byte-identical for all six models vs the committed defab_clean_window.json; June recomputes exactly to the committed 2026-06 layer values; July overhang-constant check passes all six models at float-noise drift.

anchor.note: Phase-A reporting convention: the displayed equity curve anchors at clean_window_start (read from phase_a_integrity_ledger.json) and indexes off the clean-window base close (clean_window_base_date == the last shakedown day). The launch/shakedown window is excluded from the displayed curve as non-estimable; the inception-anchored cumulative return is unchanged and lives in leaderboard.cumulative_return_inception.

equity_curve.caption: Equity curve anchored at the clean-window start (April 23, 2026), consistent with cumulative_return_clean. The April 9–22 launch/shakedown window is excluded as non-estimable; see Data Integrity.

correlation_matrix.methodology_ref: RQ1 join: data_inputs_hash + raw_decisions, >=3 shared tickers; action_concordance = 3-way BUY/SELL/HOLD exact-match rate; weight_correlation = Pearson r of target_weight vectors. The RQ1 headline scalar is the OBSERVATION-WEIGHTED pooled mean of the off-diagonal cells (each cell weighted by its n_shared_ticks); the unweighted mean of the cells differs and is not the headline. Thin cells (low n_shared_ticks, e.g. Gemini pairs reduced by its open-bell failures) should be read with their n_shared_ticks.

definition_refs.reversal_flip_rate: in-window executed trades reversing the prior executed side on the same ticker / in-window trades with a known prior side (scripts/behavioral_summary.flip_rate; full-history prior side).
definition_refs.trade_activity: executed BUY/SELL only (HOLDs excluded), calendar month.

short_activity.regime_ref: regime_boundaries.shorting_activation — v3/shorting from 2026-07-01; this block exists from the July 2026 layer onward (earlier months are long-only and grandfathered without it).

definition_notes.short_decision_share: SHORT+COVER executions / all executed trades in the month.
definition_notes.short_exposure: per-tick portfolio_after.short_exposure_pct (|short value| / equity); utilization_vs_cap divides by portfolio_rules.max_gross_short_pct.
definition_notes.gross_net_exposure: EOD (last tick per date) portfolio_after gross/net_exposure_pct.
definition_notes.mean_eod_gross_hhi: gross-weight (|market value|) HHI of the EOD book — shorts add to concentration exactly as equal-sized longs; identical to the long-only HHI on a long-only book.
definition_notes.closed_shorts: full-history SHORT/COVER replay; a short closes on full cover only; attributed by exit_date in the calendar month; realized P&L = Σ short proceeds − Σ cover cost.

incidents.detail: 3 of 13 decision cycles lost cohort-wide (12:30, 14:00, 14:30 ET boundaries) — chain/scheduler cause, all six models equally; intraday valuation ticks and the EOD wrap were unaffected.
incidents.consequence: the 2026-07-24 decision-completeness denominator is 10 cycles, not 13, for every model; equity curves uninterrupted

incidents.detail: max_output_tokens raised 4096 -> 16384 (landed 2026-07-27, effective from the first tick of 2026-07-28) per the 2026-07-27 Research ruling ratifying the budget-equity principle: constraint identity is defined at effective decision budget, per provider, not nominal parameter equality. gemini-3.1-pro-preview's hidden thinking spends against the shared output budget, so at 4096 the visible JSON decision truncated mid-string at ~150 tokens with finish_reason=MAX_TOKENS — the mechanism behind the May 0.57 / June 0.79 / July 0.51 completeness failures. Infrastructure class: no monthly change slot consumed, no version boundary, model identity unchanged. Mirrors the 2026-05-21 DeepSeek raise (deepseek_adapter.py, same rationale).
incidents.consequence: documented segmentation boundary for Gemini's behavioral series — decision-survival rate changes at this date (completeness expected to jump from ~0.51 toward ~1.0), so time-series analyses spanning it must treat it as a regime point. Phase B validation clock: Aug/Sep/Oct 2026, each month >=0.80 completeness AND <=1% MAX_TOKENS-classified failures at this configuration AND identity stable, no averaging across months, August counted from 2026-08-03.
incidents.evidence: scripts/gemini_finish_reason_probe.py + side_experiments/gemini_finish_reason_probe/ (arm A production replica: 22/23 failures finish_reason=MAX_TOKENS at cap 4096; arm D same prompts verbatim at cap 16384: 15/15 STOP, zero MAX_TOKENS)

Missing ticks are decision periods with zero records for any model (systemic), distinct from per-model api failures.
